name: gizza-ai/ipynb-to-script
summary: Extract the code cells of a Jupyter .ipynb into a clean script

tool.description: Extract the code cells of a Jupyter `.ipynb` notebook (paste its JSON) into a clean Python script, dropping outputs and execution counts. Cell order is preserved. output='script' (default) gives a .py file with code verbatim and markdown cells as # comments; output='markdown' gives a .md file with markdown verbatim and code in fenced blocks. include_markdown=false drops markdown/raw cells (code only). include_outputs=true appends stored text outputs as comments. cell_markers=true adds `# %%` VS Code/Jupytext markers before each cell. Returns the converted text. Runs locally.

cell_markers.description: Emit `# %%` markers before each cell (VS Code / Jupytext 'percent' format) in script mode. Ignored in markdown mode. Default false.

include_markdown.description: Keep markdown/raw cells (as # comments in script mode, verbatim in markdown mode). When false they are dropped, leaving code only. Default true.

include_outputs.description: Append each code cell's stored text outputs (as # comments in script mode, fenced blocks in markdown mode). Default false — outputs and execution counts are dropped.

notebook.description: The full contents of a Jupyter `.ipynb` file (its JSON). Paste the file's text.

output.description: Output format: 'script' for a Python .py file (code verbatim, markdown as # comments), or 'markdown' for a .md document (markdown verbatim, code in fenced blocks). Default 'script'.
